title: Pasta with Guanciale and Canadian Bacon
description: A simple Italian-inspired pasta dish combining guanciale, Canadian bacon, and late nights. Perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook guanciale over medium heat until crispy.
Remove guanciale from skillet and set aside.
Add Canadian bacon to skillet and cook until browned.
Add garlic to skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add cooked pasta to skillet and toss with Canadian bacon and garlic.
Return guanciale to skillet and toss with pasta.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
